name: Icefin Player
description: Icefin Player is a fork of Jellyfin Desktop with a theme engine, controller-first navigation, HDMI audio passthrough and HDR output.
notes: Icefin installs beside Flathub's Jellyfin Desktop, with its own app ID, settings and data.
If your server only lets approved devices sign in, an administrator allows Icefin Player once (Dashboard → Devices).
Controllers, audio passthrough and HDR: see the install guide.
